userEnteredValue.formulaValue: =TEXT(DATE(G1, VALUE(LEFT(D1, FIND(" ", D1 & " ") - 1)) - 1, 21), "dd/mm/yyyy") & " to " & TEXT(DATE(G1, VALUE(LEFT(D1, FIND(" ", D1 & " ") - 1)), 20), "dd/mm/yyyy")

="Period: 21 " & CHOOSE(IF(VALUE(LEFT(G1, FIND(" ", G1 & " ") - 1))=1, 12, VALUE(LEFT(G1, FIND(" ", G1 & " ") - 1)) - 1), "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December") & " - 20 " & CHOOSE(VALUE(LEFT(G1, FIND(" ", G1 & " ") - 1)), "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December") & " " & G2
